summary: First test run of FINORA. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass covering auth (login/lockout/refresh-less me/change-password revert), RBAC for admin/consultant/client (incl. RBAC on assets scoped access and read-only 403 for client), CRUD on /api/data/{entity}, dashboard/simulation/AI ask/AI report/tasks alerts/settings, CSV & XLSX export, CSV import, documents (upload/list/download/delete via GridFS), field-level encryption at rest (audit_logs.after contains 'enc:' prefix while GET returns decrypted values) and audit before/after on update. Frontend: login flow, wrong-pw error, admin dashboard renders 7 KPI cards, FINORA AI INSIGHT panel with insight groups, language selectors JA/EN/PT, header-client-scope, alerts bell, Clients page + add button, client detail with 8 tabs and Ask AI drawer + prompt chips, Reports (11 report types, report-document, PDF export button), Simulation (17 sim-* controls, milestone-10), Risk (risk-score + 8 risk-items), Documents (client/category/file/upload selectors), Settings, and Assets EntityManager (add/export csv/export xlsx/import). RBAC on frontend: client role has NO Clients nav link and NO assets-add-btn. Consultant sees exactly 3 clients and NO サクラ不動産.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Suggests JSX-styled content is placed inside a <option>. Cosmetic but produces console error.

Numerous console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' during initial mount. Charts render fine after; consider giving ResponsiveContainer a minHeight/aspect to remove noise.

action_items: (Low) Fix hydration warning: remove any <span>/JSX children inside <option> elements in language-selector or replace native <select> with the custom Select component used elsewhere.
(Low) Set an explicit height/aspect on Recharts ResponsiveContainer to remove width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings during initial mount.
critical_code_review_comments: core.decrypt swallows InvalidToken and returns '' silently. Consider logging a warning so tampered/rotated keys are detectable.

seed.upsert_user only updates the password_hash when it doesn't match; other user profile fields (name/role/client_id) are never re-synced. For the demo client user, in the else-branch (when clients already exist) the client_id is not re-linked — works only because the doc already has it from first seed.

auth_routes.login_history insertion when user is None still stores email/ip but tenant_id/user_id are null; index on tenant_id could grow unbounded across bogus emails — fine for now but consider TTL or capped collection.

crud.update_entity/create_entity: audit.after is stored as-is including encrypted values (good for tamper-evidence) but audit.before on update is the raw DB doc (also encrypted) — that's consistent. Documented in tests.

io_routes.import_data: no per-row schema validation beyond sanitize; malformed rows raise HTTPException(422) inside sanitize but other exceptions (e.g. bad numeric types) may leak as 500. Consider catch-all Exception -> row error.

routes_analytics.task_alerts uses datetime.now() (naive/local) while due_date is date-string; on containers with UTC TZ this is fine but mixing tz-naive/aware elsewhere (core.now = UTC aware) is inconsistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested selectors present and RBAC enforced
